titlu: 💘Who Should Loveity Date? Obesity, Verity or Falsi
text: Lovity, hurry, come here. >> What's going on, Noxie? >> You have to choose a new boyfriend. Obesity, Verity, or Falsity. >> What? This is really hard. Verity is super nice to me. Obesity always brings me presents. But, I've never liked Falsity. When we're alone, he tells me nice things. But, when he's with his friends, he always talks trash about me behind my back. >> You were never an option, Falsity. >> Well, now it's between Verity and Obesity. >> Verity always [music] helps me kill monsters, but I saw him really close to another girl yesterday. >> She's just my cousin. Nothing happened between us. >> I didn't know that cousins kiss each other. >> What an idiot. Pick me instead, Lovity. >> You're not in charge, Obesity. Sometimes you spend [music] days without talking to me. You stay locked in your room eating the food you stole from everyone's fridge. >> But, I'm a big guy. I need to eat to keep my muscles. Besides, I always leave a piece of pie for you. >> Only because it's not your favorite flavor. >> Does that really matter? I'll share everything next time, even my heart. >> Don't listen to his stomach, Lovity. We love each other. Don't let this fall end our love. >> I don't know what to do. Who do you guys think I should choose?
